title: Concrete Mixer applies 720-minute post-rent buffer
gherkin:
Feature: Category-specific post-rent buffer for Concrete Mixers

Scenario: Concrete Mixer enters 12-hour maintenance buffer after rental ends
  Given a Concrete Mixer is currently rented
  And the rental end date/time is reached
  When the rental is marked as completed
  Then the equipment status changes to Maintenance
  And a 720-minute (12-hour) post-rent buffer period is applied
  And the equipment remains unavailable for 720 minutes
  And after 720 minutes elapse, the equipment returns to rentable state
rationale: E13 establishes that Concrete Mixers require a 12-hour (720-minute) maintenance window as an emergency override. This test validates that the system correctly applies the category-specific buffer duration for Concrete Mixers and prevents availability until the full buffer period has elapsed.
usedContextItems: System maintains category-specific post-rent buffer periods before returning equipment to rentable state|Buffer period must elapse before item returns to normal availability|Concrete Mixers require 12-hour (720 minute) maintenance window as emergency override

Hi Team,

Regardless of what the current SRS (v1.2) says about the dynamic Maintenance Matrix, we have an emergency with Concrete Mixers. 120 minutes is absolutely not enough for proper cleaning/maintenance.

Effective immediately:
- Concrete Mixers MUST have a 12-hour (720 min) maintenance window.

Tom (Operations Lead)
